items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: We had Floyd Campbell, he was playing drums... I was playing banjo then.

ctx.x: Can you remember almost everybody else?

Yes, I can remember almost all of the fellas there. We had Floyd Campbell, he was playing drums. Faith Marable playing piano. Tom Lovingood playing piano. My father was playing bass, violin, and the sousaphone. Willie Humphrey was playing clarinet and tenor sax. Bert, oh, what's Bert's name?
